summary: Defines how to carry MPEG-4 audio and video streams in RTP packets without using MPEG-4 Systems. It obsoletes RFC 3016, fixing a mismatch with the 3GPP streaming specification for MPEG-4 audio, and it summarizes the changes and compatibility.

eli5.summary: Video and sound are big, so they are cut into small packets for sending over the internet. This explains how to slice and label MPEG-4 audio and video so the receiver can piece them back together.

questions: how to stream mpeg-4 over rtp
